References

Numbered sources, cited in the text by their number in square brackets. Each entry gives the authors, the title, where it appeared, the year, and a link. "Further reading" above lists more papers on splats.

  1. Kerbl, B., Kopanas, G., Leimkühler, T., and Drettakis, G. "3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering." ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH), 2023. arxiv.org/pdf/2308.04079
  2. Zwicker, M., Pfister, H., van Baar, J., and Gross, M. "EWA Volume Splatting." Proceedings of IEEE Visualization, 2001. cs.umd.edu/~zwicker/publications/EWAVolumeSplatting-VIS01.pdf
  3. Porter, T., and Duff, T. "Compositing Digital Images." Computer Graphics (SIGGRAPH) 18(3), 1984, pp. 253–259. doi.org/10.1145/964965.808606 (some networks refuse that address; the author-hosted copy is keithp.com/~keithp/porterduff/p253-porter.pdf)
  4. "Multivariate normal distribution." Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multivariate_normal_distribution
  5. "Quadratic form." Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quadratic_form
  6. "Affine transformation." Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Affine_transformation
  7. "Smoothstep." Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Smoothstep
  8. "Extended Backus–Naur form." Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Extended_Backus–Naur_form
  9. "Parametric surface." Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parametric_surface
  10. Kamp, R. J. "Writing toys for Splashery packs" (docs/PACKS.md). Splashery source code, 2026. github.com/ryanjosephkamp/splashery/blob/main/docs/PACKS.md
